limitations: First V2 session only; historical V1 repeats are not independent V2 reproductions.
Intervals describe within-run query-batch variation, not between-session, hardware-population, training-seed or cross-schema uncertainty.
All natural collections and outliers remain in the estimator. No GC subtraction, removal or corrected replacement speedup is claimed.
The versioned callback and timer metadata have observer overhead; no claim of zero instrumentation overhead is made.
Removing one helper reference cycle does not eliminate full GC or identify the owners of all other collectible objects.
The fixed checkpoint, schema, validation date and constants/time feature policy retain hosted-snapshot historical limitations and the activity baseline remains the stronger predictor.
Raw sampled tensors are not exported; runtime assertions establish cross-mode pairing and saved shared fingerprints independently match every archived source trial.
scope: Independent offline CPU audit of an actual NVIDIA T4 V2 run; no model evaluation, data download, new GPU experiment, source edit or historical result modification.
